notes.title: Season 3 Update
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We would like to thank you for the love and support you have shown to our game since the first day. We hope you have enjoyed the first 2 seasons enough. Now, Season 3 has been added to the game. A unique adventure awaits you with new cases, new crime scene images, and evidence. If we look at the newspapers, it seems that Kobardde will not remain very calm this season either.


New Cases! New Evidence! New Characters!

With the new season, many new pieces of evidence have been added to the game. Additionally, we have completely revised the old camera recordings from previous seasons that you did not like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/5586c37c5c98ce1c861e6e73f63df51be83303b9.gif

New Crime Scenes = New Mysteries Waiting to be Solved

With the new season, we have added crime scenes so that you don’t miss any details in the cases. We recommend that you pay attention to the reports before making a decision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/c415fad2a839fb23a45c01365958a0093f3fa53c.gif

Achievements Exclusive to Season 3!

There are now exactly 30 achievements in the game, and they are all waiting for you to unlock them! As you can see from the image below, we have changed the achievement appearances according to your requests. There are some very difficult achievements among them, just to let you know in advance. (Even the game’s developer had a hard time getting some of them.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/22ddcad7a67430781a81f51395fc6d36485462ba.png

Rumors About New Languages!

You are the Judge! is largely a text-based game. Therefore, it is very important for us that players can play this game in their own languages! For this reason, we would like to announce that with the help of the community, we will be adding various languages to the game in the coming weeks. If you would also like to play the game in your own language, we would be very happy if you could help us with the translation! You can contact us through our Discord server for this.

Is that all?

Some time has passed before Season 3 was added to the game. Therefore, if you have played the first 2 seasons recently and do not want to start over from the beginning, we have added a shortcut for you. Please note that this is not recommended for new players and it disables achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/43c52b397360b6beb1147bc7ce63486fb91296a2.png

Additionally, we have fixed the bugs you reported throughout the game and made performance improvements for you. If the problem you are experiencing persists or if you encounter a new bug, please do not hesitate to let us know.


Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, we recommend starting a new game for a better gaming experience.

Your feedback is very important to us. This way, we can take the game to an even higher level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: 1.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We continue to improve the game based on the feedback we receive from you. First, we would like to mention a few important changes that we consider significant. You can find all the other details included in this update below.


Loyalty levels of institutions and individuals!

With the addition of the new interface to the game, as a result of the choices you make after the trial and the decisions you make in the trial, you will now see a new story screen. This new interface will include events that have occurred in the country depending on various factors or the results of your choices. Additionally, based on the situations we mentioned earlier, you will have a certain level of loyalty with various institutions and individuals. (This loyalty level is different from relationships.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/75c5788bd62c0336ca75025647cbde867444676d.gif

Having a low or high level of loyalty can present you with various challenges or make your tasks easier. For example, if your loyalty level with the public is low, it can make your job more difficult in the courtroom, while having a high loyalty level with the press can result in fewer people learning about the consequences of your wrong decisions.

Criminal records are now more easily accessible!

Currently, when you talk to someone in the courtroom, you can check and view their criminal record through their ID card. However, since you cannot talk to that person again, it does not allow you to check it later. Regarding this issue, now, if there is a criminal record or records in a case, a button will be activated for you, and you will be able to perform your checks by using this button as you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/647e841c249e70cfb4dab2a60a0a8cf3555c6e89.gif

Is that all?
You can see other details included in this update in the list below.

- The interface and functions of the KJS system on your computer have been improved.
- You can now view the average of the ratings you received after the trials.
- Improvements have been made and errors have been fixed for better operation of the game in windowed mode.
- Improvements have been made for high-resolution computers.
- All incorrect or faulty assistant messages have been corrected.
- Name errors in the final case of the first season have been corrected.
- The issue of text occasionally extending beyond the frame in the speech bar has been fixed.
- Fixes have been made for errors affecting a small number of players.
- Performance improvement has been made.

Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, for a better gaming experience, we recommend starting a new game.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few minor bug fixes. If your issue persists or if you encounter a new error, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Your feedback is very important to us. It allows us to take the game to the next level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We continue to improve the game based on the feedback we receive from you. First, we would like to mention a few important changes that we consider significant. You can find all the other details included in this update below.


Case justifications and independent commission reviews!

As a judge, when making decisions in cases, it is your natural right to write the justification for your decision and explain the basis of the decision you give to people. Now, you will be able to write the reasoning related to the case when making a decision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/8ee4f81b52c2bf9ee10f48f0ab606170f5618cf9.gif

Additionally, by accessing the KJS on your office computer, you will find in the reports section an evaluation of the decisions you made in past cases, as well as the independent commission members' assessment of your decisions and performance. This assessment will be represented by a score. The accuracy of the decisions you made, the right to speak granted to parties in court, and many other different factors contribute to this score. Depending on the level of these scores, you may experience various effects within the game, including the Supreme Court.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/82b7e65ccd789d8ee33c2bfab5f22909c9c14c12.gif

Occupational information of the individuals involved in the case!

The profession of the person you are speaking to can be of great importance when making a decision in a case. This way, you can assess their knowledge on the subject they are talking about. Who knows, maybe this situation can convince you that the person is giving a false statement. This feature, present in the early versions of the game, is now active again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/34cbe3e65d3af835bf561f6250c0c5aaebff314f.png

Is that all?
You can see other details included in this update in the list below.

- With the update we released in recent days, we improved the game's performance and reduced the usage of the graphics card.
- You can now file a lawsuit for all posts on social media.
- A new crime scene report has been added to the harbor scene.
- The page system in the court case file has been activated.
- We bid farewell to the New Year tree in the office, but if you received the snow globe gift before, this item will continue to stay with you.

Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, for a better gaming experience, we recommend starting a new game.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few minor bug fixes. If your issue persists or if you encounter a new error, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Your feedback is very important to us. It allows us to take the game to the next level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: 1.09 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

New Year is just around the corner. We sincerely thank you for being with us in the You are the Judge! adventure that we launched in the last months of 2023. We hope the year 2023 has been wonderful for you as well.

We continue to improve the game based on the feedback we receive from you. First, we would like to mention a few important changes that we consider significant. You can find all the other details included in this update below.


In the office scene, there are updates and bug fixes!

We noticed that some players were unsure about what could be clicked when they first entered the office scene. To address this, we've added an effect to make clickable objects more visually distinct when you hover the mouse over them. Additionally, there's a Christmas tree in your office for the New Year celebration. It seems your spouse left a note on the Christmas tree. You might want to take a look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/b10ae1decbe98497d7792728d72aaa86fb6d25eb.gif

In the recent updates, some of our players mentioned that the statistics panel we added to the computer screen was affecting their role-playing experience. Therefore, we have now made this panel toggleable, allowing players to open or close it as they wish. Players who prefer can keep this panel closed and continue their game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/b217d0a19d211db9745e036d7826e50e13e1c7fc.gif

Is that all?
You can see other details included in this update in the list below.

- An addition has been made to clarify the wording in the law text of the first case in Season 1.
- Issues related to the constitution and country panels in the office scene have been fixed.
- The problem of being able to click on the computer while the menu is open in the office scene has been resolved.
- Issues with joysticks or other various controllers connected to the computer have been addressed.
- Spelling errors in the office and courtroom scenes have been corrected.
- Optimization has been performed for loading screens.
- The issue of obtaining various achievements incorrectly has been fixed.
- Translation errors in the Turkish language have been corrected.
- The menu has been activated in the pre-trial hearing section.
- Changes have been made to the chapter visuals.

Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, for a better gaming experience, we recommend starting a new game.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few minor bug fixes. If your issue persists or if you encounter a new error, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Your feedback is very important to us. It allows us to take the game to the next level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

Now, we believe that the new interface is more understandable and effective. Additionally, with this update, in some cases, attorneys will convey some of their opinions related to the case directly to you. Whether this will affect you or not is entirely up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/099f3a4913aaacd40a7707c511848a2aa89fdc72.gif

notes.title: 1.06 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We are aware that this update is somewhat delayed, and we apologize for that. We are doing our best to provide a better gaming experience.

We continue to improve the game based on the feedback we receive from you. First, we would like to mention a few important changes that we consider significant. You can find all the other details included in this update below.


New evidence file and a new television!

Since the game's release, the visual and functional aspects of the evidence didn't fully satisfy us. With this update, we have addressed this issue. Now, there is no tablet in the courtroom scene. Instead, we have a genuine file appearance. We believe this enhances the narrative power of the case file.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/288a5cd6a1beb82a7434c19698925c2dd57fc9c1.gif

Additionally, you may have wondered how security camera recordings will be viewed now that there is no tablet. To ensure a more authentic courtroom experience, we have facilitated further investment by the Kobardde Ministry of Justice and added a television to the courtroom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/695d02966e4a74ade67b81b5fa96cdf5aed7a017.gif

Do you forget to check your office computer?

We enjoy watching videos and streams where content creators play our game. Additionally, in communication with our community on Discord, we've noticed that players weren't always aware of what was happening on their office computers. For example, you had to open your computer to see if you had a new message. With the newly added icon, you can now easily tell if you have a message. (You won't get scolded anymore for not seeing the Minister of Justice's messages :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/9b9dc732c0344b88d785ed0292cf7cb4e931ffc8.gif

Is that all?
You can see other details included in this update in the list below.

- Decision options in two cases from Season 1 and Season 2 have been modified and made more fitting to the respective cases.
- Game interfaces have been adjusted for players using high-resolution monitors.
- You will now be able to access the decision screen by clicking on the gavel on your desk during the trial.
- Instead of using a tablet for note-taking (given that there's no tablet now), you can use the notepad on your desk.
- Appearances of various icons and symbols in the game have been corrected.
- The appearances of objects in some crime scene scenes have been fixed.
- Improvements have been made to the interface you use to share a new post on social media.
- Typos from Season 2 have been corrected.

Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, for a better gaming experience, we recommend starting a new game.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few minor bug fixes. If your issue persists or if you encounter a new error, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Your feedback is very important to us. It allows us to take the game to the next level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

With the Season 2 update, many new types of evidence have been added to the game!

notes.title: 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We are continuing to improve the game based on the feedback we have received from you. At the end of this update, we will also be sharing some of our future plans with you. First and foremost, we would like to discuss a few important fixes with you.


 We have reorganized the crime scenes from scratch!

We received feedback that some of our players were experiencing confusion in crime scenes. Additionally, we decided that the gameplay was not up to par. As a result, from now on, evidence will be presented to you clearly in crime scenes, and you will have access to a detailed crime scene report for each piece of evidence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/dc9e9098b7e2c86dcfada3c30108c6bd1e6e5fe1.gif

When you make a wrong decision, don't forget to check why you received a penalty!

In the previous update, we had added a file to the office that allows you to find out the reason for receiving a penalty when you make a wrong decision in cases. However, we noticed that some of our users were not aware of this and missed clicking on the file. Therefore, we have added an animation to remind you that you need to click on the file to learn the reason for receiving a penalty the day after it occurs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/226b74ab3b5b1f866a8ea6e0a7577bf8fe6c7aae.gif

The criminal records of individuals involved in the case can be important!

Since the game's release, it has been possible to access the characters' criminal records, but our players may have been overlooking this. Therefore, we have added an animation that indicates you can access the criminal record by clicking on the identities of individuals with criminal records. We believe this makes it more prominent now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/93dec1da7482d23a72f1a264b3a158fadd9863b7.gif

Is that all?
You can see the other details included in this update in the list below.

- Graphic settings added.
- Improved the appearance of security camera footages.
- Improvements made to the readability of Kobardde Journal newspaper.
- Fixed incorrect newspaper headlines.

Note: This update can work with your old save file. However, for a better gaming experience, we recommend starting a new game.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few minor bug fixes. If your issue persists or if you encounter a new error, please do not hesitate to contact us.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

We would like to express our heartfelt thanks for your interest in You are the Judge! despite it being not too long since its release. Along with the fantastic feedback we've received from you, we've added some new content and made various bug fixes. First and foremost, we would like to discuss a few important corrections with you.


 Now, when you make a wrong decision, you will be able to easily understand the reason for it!

When you make a wrong decision, all you need to do is open the folder in your office. The Supreme Court Board will have sent you a notification regarding your incorrect decision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/9f07a2dd2c6ed207532c4606a6164c8d16ebd1f2.gif

Does the attitude of the people in the courtroom matter to you?

Our ultimate goal is to leave the freedom of what kind of judge you will be entirely up to you. That's why we want to enhance your control over individuals. In your future cases, you may want to take a look at the small notepad on your desk.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/d5f301bc5e7008b227934eb5f7c7506246e8a4fc.gif

Is your phone ringing??

Kobardde has a somewhat murky past. There may be those who occasionally want to disturb you. Perhaps they will want you to change your decision in a case. Frankly, we can't listen to your phone conversations, but we are very curious. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/c5466928287b0d4a69e6088db08ab312fbaf3f99.gif

Determining the amount of the penalty on the decision-making screen is no longer a problem!

Yes, while there wasn't an issue when imposing a prison sentence, entering the amount for a fine could sometimes result in very large figures with a small increment. We now have a solution for this. You will be able to enter the value you want yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/4ef9718643693dc26fa3c665e9ef3d0da2fe613b.gif

We are putting an end to the debates about the card selection screen!

Some of our players really love this feature, while others don't like it at all. To please both sides, we have added a new setting. With this new option, players who wish can disable this feature and get rid of the card selection screen. (I quite liked it.) :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/77b653b2633ed8de4b08bdad9a6f7336eb9ef1d1.gif

It seems that press freedom is improving in Kobardde!

Two new newspapers, Kobardde Journal and Kobardde Post, have recently started publication. I guess they will inform readers through their op-ed columns. I'm curious about the attitudes of these columnists, to be honest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/0a82aa3e224f7601825537c12e45afb11b200415.png

We made adjustments textually in Season 1 cases!

We are aware that some witnesses in the courtrooms were constructing rather artificial sentences, and we know that this was negatively affecting the gameplay experience for our valued players. Firstly, we apologize for this situation. We have reviewed all the cases in the first season and eliminated such occurrences!

Your new assistant seems to have grasped the job a bit now!

We all go through an adjustment period when starting a new job. Your assistant, Robin, has gone through this process as well. Now, to prove that they have overcome this phase, she will discuss the impact of your previous case's decision on the press, public, and institutions every day. We believe she is conducting valuable research, and we recommend you take it into consideration.

Is that all?

We have also made numerous bug fixes and balance adjustments in relationships. You can view other fixes and new content additions in the list below.

- Language issues on loading screens have been fixed
- Text corruption issues in dialogues with the police in crime scenes have been resolved.
- Rain sound in the office scene has been reduced.
- Character controls have been adjusted.
- Adjustments have been made to newspapers, the constitution book, and panels containing information about the country.
- Translation errors on the meeting page have been corrected.
- Tutorial translation errors have been fixed.
- The home scene has been removed. (It will return in the future with new content.)
- Penalty durations have been added to the constitution texts.
- Season 2 update date has been changed. (We are continuing to improve the game based on the feedback we receive from you. Therefore, we had to postpone the Season 2 date for a while. Stay tuned for a much more comprehensive and content-rich Season 2.)

Note: This update may work with your old save file. However, starting a new game is still recommended for a better experience.

In addition to all of these, we have made a few more minor bug fixes. If the issue you're experiencing persists or if you encounter a new error, please don't hesitate to report it to us.

Your feedback is very important to us. It allows us to take the game to an even higher level.

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: You are the Judge! is releasing on October 2, 2023!
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

It’s official!  You are the Judge! will be available to players on October 2, 2023. We are very excited about this release announcement and hope you are too. You are the Judge is releasing with a 15% launch discount.

First and foremost, we would like to thank all the players who have shared their thoughts and feedback with us. Since releasing our demo version, we have made numerous improvements based on the input we've received from you. And now, we are in the final countdown towards the release of the full version.

As a team with limited resources, we have strived to do our best. Now, we would like to share with you a few of the many different features that will be present in the full version.


NEW AND REALISTIC TYPES OF EVIDENCE!

It appears that the Kobardde Ministry of Justice has invested in technology to make court proceedings more effective. As a result, as a judge, you will now have access to much more realistic types of evidence!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/e8be3cb86151c99e3d79c77893146b8190e77512.gif

DETAILED CRIMINAL RECORD DATA!

The communication issues with the police department in the past have been resolved. Now, you will be able to access detailed criminal record data of a defendant present in the court. We will all see together whether these data will have an impact on the decisions you make. As the development team, we always take our place among the audience!😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/79c0edfe7f374a6e1a2474440fa8e731b403f505.png

WHAT'S ON THE COUNTRY'S AGENDA? LET'S LEARN STRAIGHT FROM THE PEOPLE!

This computer's sole function isn't just social media! With the computer present in your office and home (Home, is it? 😊), you'll now have access to various mechanics. Additionally, we recommend being cautious about the posts you share on social media. As it could strain your relations with different groups. Just a friendly heads-up from us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/44fce7fd501c9f09520c93b7387f7e87c10feb73.gif

INCIDENT SCENES FOR YOU TO EXAMINE WHEN NEEDED!

We acknowledge that Kobardde is an unconventional country. Being a judge in this country might require different tasks from time to time. You might be asked to take a look at the crime scene for a case you'll be presiding over soon. Below, we're sharing one of the scenes that we've carefully prepared for you. We hope these scenes assist you in your cases. (Note: Unfortunately, we can't show the inside of the container in the GIF below; otherwise, the surprise might be spoiled. 😊)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/ccae0914dd1552ebdc231a0fb06e7ba12cc2ebb3.gif

IS THAT ALL?

Absolutely not! However, sharing everything here could spoil the surprises you'll encounter in the full version. We've already given a few spoiler hints about several different features within the announcement. We'd love for you to join us on October 2, 2023, to experience all the other features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/eac9f35c4d90e8fd549e95d610fb113060dc829d.png

We sincerely thank all the players who have been with us throughout the development process!

And, let's not forget to add, if you haven't yet added our game to your wishlist, it's never too late to do so.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305180/You_are_the_Judge/

You can join our official Discord server for announcements, updates, and special events.
Steel Games Discord Link

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.3
notes.content:
Dear Judge,

Thank you very much for your interest in the You are the Judge! demo version. We are thrilled by this interest. Our players are sharing their feedback with us through the Community Hub and Discord, and we are making improvements accordingly.

Some of our players have complained about the slow speed of the in-game texts. As a solution to this issue, we have added an option to adjust the speed of the dialogue texts according to your preference. You can access this option through the settings panel in the main menu or the menu button on the office and courtroom screens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594125/61b421505301bde32ae96ca5762f300c4689e334.gif

Below, we are sharing with you all the fixes included in this update.


 Added an option for players to adjust the speed of in-game texts according to their preference.
 Fixed a crash issue on the card screen.
 Fixed a language issue on the end-of-day screen.
 Renamed the "Friends" menu to avoid confusion.
 Fixed audio issues in story scenes.
 Fixed language issues in cases.
 Fixed percentage issues in the "Relations" screen.
 Corrected narrative inconsistencies in the introductory story.
 Fixed the issue of background files remaining on the screen when the verdict form appeared in the courtroom scene.
 Fixed double-clicking issues on certain buttons.
 Balanced some relationship and interaction levels.
 Fixed a language issue in the main menu.


We have also fixed minor errors not listed here. We apologize to the players who encountered issues in their previous playthroughs before this update. We will continue to make updates based on the feedback we receive from you.

We didn't want to end without a small reminder, adding our game to your wishlist greatly benefits us. You can also join our Discord server to communicate with us directly.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

First and foremost, we would like to emphasize that we are able to release these updates thanks to the feedback you have provided us. We are immensely grateful for that!

During the demo phase of our game, some of our users expressed their dissatisfaction with the absence of a tutorial. As a team, we found this outcry to be entirely justified and immediately started working on it. With this update we have released, the game now includes a tutorial. Through the tutorial, you can familiarize yourself with the basic mechanics of the game.

The tutorial will be active in your first case when you start a new game. So, you don't need to do anything to activate it.

Note: For those users who state that they do not need the tutorial, we haven't forgotten to add a button to skip it.

To be honest, it was a rather short update, but we believe it is a lifesaver for the users who made this request.

By the way, let's make an addition: if you haven't added our game to your wishlist yet, it's never too late to do so. Additionally, you can join our official Discord server to connect with us directly.

For now, that's all from us, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games

notes.title: Demo Update Notes 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Your Honor,

In our previous announcement, we mentioned that we would be in touch again. We wanted to inform you about our new demo update without further delay. We would also like to express our gratitude for your interest in the demo version of our game.

During the demo phase, many of our users shared the bugs they encountered and provided suggestions. It was our responsibility to implement these improvements as quickly as possible. If you're ready, let's take a look at what has changed:


 The legal text related to your case has been added to the courtroom scene.
 Story scenes have been completely redesigned.
 Additional information about the defendant and plaintiff has been included on the decision screen in the courtroom scene to help you better understand the decision you made.
 The settings tab in the menu has been activated.
 You can now continue conversations during the pre-trial hearing.
 After finding evidence in the crime scene, you can continue exploring the scene.
 Music and sound effects have been added to the office, courtroom, and story scenes.
 Visual improvements have been made to enhance the comprehension of values displayed on the end-of-day screen.
 An option to skip the intro at the beginning has been added. (No need to wait for it to finish anymore 😊.)
 An error that occurred occasionally when trying to talk to friends has been fixed.
 Language issues have been addressed.
 Meaningful corrections and visual adjustments have been made to the opening screen where you make choices related to your career.
 A bug related to a bribery letter has been fixed.
 Adjustments have been made to the scenery in the office scene.
 Typographical errors in the pre-trial hearings have been corrected.
 Typographical errors in the identities of some characters have been fixed.
 Confusion in the file of the first case has been resolved.
 UI improvements have been made to the end-of-game screens.

We have also fixed many other minor errors that are not mentioned here. We apologize to our users who encountered errors in their previous playthroughs before this update. We are continuing to work at full speed on the full version of our game. Soon, we will also be releasing content announcements related to the full version.

Before we conclude, we would like to remind you that adding our game to your wishlist greatly benefits us. Additionally, you can directly communicate with us by joining our Discord server.

That's all for now, but we will definitely be in touch again soon!

Steel Games
